India Considers 15% Isobutanol Blending in Diesel

The Indian government is exploring the possibility of blending up to 15% isobutanol into diesel fuel. This move is intended to reduce the country's reliance on crude oil imports. Isobutanol is considered a promising biofuel due to its high energy density, compatibility with current diesel engines, and lower emission profile compared to other biofuels.
